name: X
author: Jacob Vincent-Mink
description: Adds bounded public mentions and selected public-account activity through the official X API.

categories.label: Mentions
categories.description: Public posts that mention the configured X username.

categories.label: Selected account activity
categories.description: Recent public posts from explicitly configured X accounts.

setup.summary: Uses an X developer app bearer token for read-only public API access. This is app-only authentication, not OAuth user access.

fields.label: Bearer token
fields.description: App-only bearer token from the X Developer Console.

fields.label: Your X username
fields.description: Username to look up and use for public mention matching, without the @ sign.

fields.label: Selected accounts
fields.description: Optional comma-separated public usernames whose recent posts should be included (maximum 5).
